notes: Harker Experi(Mental): 18 teams, guillotine, and the only league with IDP. The 2025 draft cleared its defensive players between rounds 7 and 11, peaking at 8-11, which is what these deadlines are built around. Caveat: only 42% of that draft's Yahoo player ids resolved to positions, and defensive players are the ones most likely to be missing, so the real IDP concentration may start earlier than it looks.

rules.label: RB-RB start
rules.note: Eighteen teams means replacement level is brutal everywhere. Anchor the backfield first.

rules.label: Linebacker by round 10
rules.note: Linebackers are the deepest and most valuable IDP group in this scoring (2 per solo tackle, 1 per assist), and they were the most-drafted IDP position in rounds 7-11 last year. Being the last team without one in an 18-team league is expensive.

rules.label: Defensive lineman by round 11
rules.note: Sacks pay 6 here, so the top edge rushers carry real weekly upside. They went a round or so after the linebackers in 2025.

rules.label: Defensive back by round 12
rules.note: The flattest of the three groups — safeties who play every snap are close to interchangeable, so this is the one to leave latest.

rules.label: QB after the top two
rules.note: Not paying up for Josh Allen or Lamar Jackson.

rules.label: Rookies and handcuffs late
rules.note: Once every starting slot is filled, the picks before kicker and defence go on the best rookie receivers and on the best available handcuffs — upside and insurance rather than veteran depth. A back-up behind one of your own starters comes first, since it insures a player you have already paid for; the rest follow. Verified across the 2026 mocks: nine of fourteen picks in this window were already one or the other.
